content:
Best Buy has refreshed its massive 60th anniversary celebration sale with new deals. We are still tracking 25% off AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and the lowest price ever on AirTag 2. However, today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also features Amazon's $500 off 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, Anker's new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card down to a $25 all-time low, and Mint Mobile's unlimited talk/data 1-year plan at half off — just $15 per month. Full details below.

Best Buy refreshes massive 60th anniversary sale with new deals: TVs from $110, tech up to 50% off, home appliances $1,000 off, more

AirPods deals drop further, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more

After steady deals on Apple's latest AirPods lineup throughout the summer, nearly every model has dropped even further in price. The beloved AirPods Pro 3 are now available at 25% off, one of the best prices ever. We're also seeing AirPods 4 with ANC down to their lowest price in months, and AirPods Max 2 received an additional $120 markdown earlier this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

Today's rare M4 Mac mini deal surfaces at Apple's official refurbished store for $150 off

Update: this deal has sold out and we'll be watching for restocks.

Deals on AirPods Pro 3, the new AirTag 2, M5 MacBook Pros, and more have been plentiful, but the latest M4 Mac mini has been extremely difficult to find. It's nearly impossible to get from retailers like Amazon and Best Buy — where these deals typically pop up. We've now spotted a rare opportunity at Apple's official refurbished store to grab a 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini for $150 off.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is now shipping the M4 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $849 with free shipping.

New low: Amazon's $500 off 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro

This week brought $400 off on brand new M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations as part of a 1-day Apple event. But we wanted to focus on one specific model — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $500 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now shipping the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB internal SSD for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the regularly configured $3,199 model with the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU version is currently $400 off). Even though this machine just went up in price, it's still $100 less than its original lower MSRP.

Both options are great depending on how much power you need — both are now $400 and $500 off retail, and normally you'd pay $200 more for the upgraded CPU/GPU, but with today's deals, you're only paying $100 more:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (originally $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We expect the $500 markdown to go back up shortly, but we can't be sure whether it will last until Sunday, when this week's big sale event wraps up.

Apple's newest AirTag 2 drops to all-time low at Amazon this week, but here's how to get one for $20

Apple deals are flying this week, with AirPods Pro 3 still at 25% off and AirPods Max 2 seeing one of the best markdowns yet at $120 off. Along with $500 off select M5 Pro MacBook Pro models, some of the more notable discounts have landed on the latest AirTag 2 trackers, with both single and 4-packs returning to all-time lows — but you can still get a single one for $20 right now.

Amazon has now reduced both the single and 4-pack AirTag 2 to the lowest prices we've tracked since their launch earlier this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

That brings the per-unit average on the 4-pack down to just $22.25, and the single AirTag 2 back to its Prime Day all-time low of $24.

Although it's not much lower, it's worth noting that Best Buy's 'Premium' open-box AirTag 2 single pack is also at its tracked all-time low — available for $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 'Premium' open-box $20 (originally $29 new) | Best Buy

Although it's only $4 less than the brand new one at Amazon, I'd personally go for the new one, but it is technically a lower price. If you're about to place an order as part of Best Buy's ongoing 60th anniversary sale, it's worth keeping that option in mind.

Apple Watch Series 11 hits $100 off during celebration week, Best Buy open-box from $254

Anker's new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card supports iOS or Android, down to $25 Amazon all-time low

Anker recently launched its new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card — its first product that supports both Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — and it's now down to a new Amazon all-time low of $25 with Prime shipping.

Anker's official EufyHome store on Amazon is now selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 for $24.99 with support for iOS or Android, free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

The card first hit Amazon last month at a $35 price point, saw a minor $5 markdown at the end of the month, and is now seeing its first significant discount, setting a new Amazon low.

At nearly 30% off, it's in line with some of the better wallet tracker card deals we've seen this year.

I'm personally a big fan of the Nomad Tracking Card — they start at $35, with the Pro version going up to $45, featuring a 16-month battery life that needs recharging — but regardless of which one you choose, I think everyone should have one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave home without it.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 offers all the most important features, including wireless charging, and supports both the Apple Find My platform and Google Find Hub. It's only 1.7mm thin, with a ring volume of up to 80 decibels to help you find it nearby — and of course, it integrates directly with the Find My and Find Hub apps so you can see its location on a map.

Mint Mobile now offering unlimited talk/data 1-year plan at half off, just $15 per month

Mint Mobile is currently running an outrageous deal on its unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plan. While this carrier offers great value most of the year, it's now slashed its unlimited 12-month plan to just $15 per month — half off — bringing the total to just $180 for a full year of unlimited talk, text, and data. Even if you're not planning to switch your primary plan right now, this price is so low it's worth considering as a backup or iPad line.

While their 17GB and 23GB plans are also discounted, the best value is the 5G • 4G LTE plan: 12 months unlimited/MO for just $15 per month.

  • Mint Mobile 12-month unlimited plan $15/month (half off)

According to the fine print, you'll need to pay the $180 12-month plan fee upfront (equivalent to $15/month), but for anyone looking to switch carriers at a discounted rate or add a line for another device/as a backup, this is an incredible deal.

You can 'activate service instantly if your phone supports eSIM,' which works with a range of Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. If needed, you can keep your existing number and bring an unlocked phone when switching.

Head to the deal page for more details.

New wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low at Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired version also on sale)

As part of a late-summer round of markdowns on Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home products, Amazon is also offering the all-time lowest price on the new wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro, and has discounted the wired version back to its Prime Day all-time low — both versions are nearly 30% off MSRP.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker MagSafe power banks start at $36 this week with free shipping (plenty of color options)
  • Anker 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger is a top-tier option, now 35% off (matching all-time low)
  • Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the best-looking MagSafe stands I've seen, $27 (originally $35)
  • Twelve South's all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C charger now just $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5-foot cable, $36 today
  • Woot's massive PC sale now live, up to 75% off gaming desktops, monitors, coolers, more from $5
  • This compact SSD enclosure with built-in display features power loss protection, just $29 today
  • Razer portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub slashed to $52 all-time low (57% off)
  • Twelve South Find My-equipped USB-C wall charger now at Amazon all-time low, under $37
  • Wow — these leather Apple Watch bands just $6 with Prime shipping (75% off)

Amazon now has all five colors of AirPods Max 2 at $120 off (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th anniversary sale has brought one of the best prices ever on Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering $120 off across all five colors.

Amazon is now shipping the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Compared to the same $549 MSRP as the previous generation, that's $120 in savings — the best price we've found from a reputable retailer in brand new condition right now.

Best Buy's 'Premium' open-box Midnight Black version is $403.99 with free shipping, which is lower but not low enough to justify giving up on a brand new unit.

Apple has truly launched a new generation of AirPods Max this year, unlike the previous version which just got new colors and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, these over-ear headphones won't be updated at next month's new product unveiling, so this week we're looking at potentially the best time to grab the newest, most powerful version of Apple's over-ear headphones with a $120 discount.

Only one previous sale event has been cheaper than this — the Prime Day earlier this summer, when this model was priced $30 lower than what we're seeing now — but that 4-day sale had very limited and unstable stock.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro is now $220 off (matching Prime Day pricing)

While Apple's official certified refurbished store is my go-to for iPhone deals, Apple isn't currently selling their newest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, which seems to be waiting until after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed listings are now back at Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off the brand new MSRP.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed models have consistently been the best way to get an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Not only do you save hundreds of dollars, you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty promise and 'greater than 90% original battery life' — non-'Premium' Renewed and refurbished models on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty, and the battery life guarantees differ.

Both the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back in stock now, with up to $220 off — the 512GB version is even $20 less than what we mentioned last time:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)

As mentioned in yesterday's Apple refurbished store feature, you can grab a powerful iPhone 16 model with 1 year of Apple warranty from $699, and the 1TB 16 Pro Max is just $1,269 — that's $330 less than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 less than 17 series)
